content_record.title: Itch and pain split by a single gene switch in spinal neurons
content_record.editorial_body: A preprint reveals that Grpr+ spinal neurons contain two subtypes—Tac1+ for mechanical allodynia, Tac1− for itch—and shows genomic enhancers can silence each to reverse symptoms. Grpr+ neurons split into Tac1+ (pain) and Tac1− (itch) subtypes. Silencing Tac1+ reverses mechanical allodynia; Tac1− silencing stops itch. Inhibitory circuits and GRP sensitivity shape modality-specific output. This signal is based on A molecular and spinal circuit basis for the functional segregation of itch and pain from biorxiv. Read the original report for full context.
